run_pytorch_op_benchmark: run a PyTorch operator benchmark for torch.mm with forward and backward pass metrics
create_bench_config: create a benchmark configuration for a given PyTorch operator name like torch.mm
create_op_args: create operator arguments from positional tensor inputs and keyword arguments for benchmarking
make_op_config: make an OperatorConfig that initializes the operator workload and input data generators
run_op_executor: run an OpExecutor to execute a PyTorch operator workload and collect benchmark metrics
